page.title: Diagnostics
page.description: What this machine is running and the recent errors it recorded. Everything here is read on your computer; the app sends none of it anywhere.
page.note: If you report a problem, this is what to send: it tells your setup apart from someone else's.

backendUnavailable.title: The backend did not answer
backendUnavailable.body: Its part of this report is missing. What the app itself knows is below, and that is usually enough to describe a backend that will not start.

report.heading: Report a problem
report.privacyNote: Logs can contain the text of your conversations and the names of your documents, because nothing leaves your machine. Read what you copy before you post it publicly.
report.instruction: To report something you noticed, copy this, open the bug report form and paste it into the Logs field. Describe what happened and add a screenshot if you have one.
report.contactLink: Write to us on the contact page
report.contactSuffix: and include everything above, plus any screenshots you have.

boundary.title: This screen stopped working
boundary.body: Something in the interface threw an error the app could not recover from on its own. Your conversations, models and knowledge bases are untouched — reloading the window is safe.
